Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather you just refer to me as the claimant, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: We were on the feeder road heading east in Katy, Texas, in the right lane. I was riding in the front passenger seat.
Q: What was the driver of your vehicle doing right before impact?
A: We were slowing down because traffic had bunched up ahead. I don't think we were going fast at all.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I was looking at my phone for a second. The first thing I noticed was a loud bang and our car shoved
sideways.
Q: Did the other vehcile appaer to be changing lanes?
A: I believe so. It came over from the lane to our left and clipped the side of our car. The driver never seemed to
check before moving over, as far as I could tell.
Q: Did you hit anything else or leave the vehicle at any point?
A: No. We pulled onto the shoulder and waited for the police. I stayed in my seat until the paramedics came.
Q: Can you describe your injuries?
A: My left wrist hurt badly right away. I put my hand out to brace myself against the dashboard. They took X-rays at
the hospital and said the wrist was fractured. I've been in a splint since then and I have a follow-up with a hand
specialist.
Q: Have you received any treatment since the hospital visit?
A: Yes, I've been doing physical therapy twice a week. It's still hard to grip things and I can't work the way I used to.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm willing to share my medical records and provide any other documents you need.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
